rework.caveat: reopened counted from tasks.reopened_count (wq#841), a monotonic column bumped on every terminal->in-flight transition. Authoritative from 2026-08-23 onward only: before that, rework was inferred from a mutable `notes LIKE '%REOPENED%'` substring that any later `wq done` erased, so every rework figure dated before this epoch UNDERCOUNTS by an unknown amount and is NOT comparable with figures dated after it. See reports/wq841_rework_rate_durability.md.
